# ffxf_plan (Data Source)

Looks up an FFXF Cloud compute plan by slug, including its capacity, availability, and prices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_plan" "nano" {
  slug = "nano"
}

resource "ffxf_instance" "web" {
  hostname = "web-01"
  plan     = data.ffxf_plan.nano.slug
  region   = "montreal"
  image    = "debian-13"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Stable plan slug, such as nano.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name of the plan.
- `description` (String) Intended workload for the plan.
- `vcpu` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk capacity in GiB.
- `traffic_tb` (Number) Included traffic in TiB, or null when unmetered.
- `port_mbps` (Number) Network port speed in Mbps.
- `regions` (List of String) Region slugs where the plan is offered.
- `status` (String) Availability status of the plan.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices by currency. Monetary amounts are decimal strings to avoid rounding errors.

#### `prices` Attributes

- `currency` (String)
- `hourly` (String)
- `hourly_month_equivalent` (String)
- `hourly_stopped` (String) Null when the currency has no reduced stopped rate.
- `monthly` (String)
- `annual` (String)
- `setup_fee` (String)
